EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Publicly available shipping and schedule data indicate that product tanker Stellar Vane ceases AIS transmission for 14 hours east of Ostrand.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Stellar Vane.

3. The publication does not identify its own sourcing and gives no dateline beyond 0251Z.

4. Schedule data show 3 affected sailings, all within the period 2316Z to 0025Z.

5. The account is consistent with commercial reporting of the same period and contains no detail not already publicly available.

6. Open reporting establishes that the event was publicly visible. It establishes nothing about military significance.
